params.body:
Vera, the review product, is removed.

- `src/pages/vera.astro` is removed. `/vera` and `/vera/*` redirect to the homepage (301), as the site does for other addresses that used to be public.
- Vera's night hue leaves `globals.css`. The trust page names only ProveML for checking claims. The README, the brand guide and the parked keys page no longer present Vera as current. Dated notes and the signed blog post are unchanged.
- `scripts/did-webvh.mjs`: `--remove` assigned to an undeclared `invocation`, so building any version that removed a role threw a `ReferenceError` before the version was built (no key was spent). The line is removed, and the summary now names the roles a version removed. Rehearsed on a throwaway log with software keys: the old script fails on `rotate --remove`, and the fixed one writes a version without the removed roles that verifies.

`public/id/did.jsonl` and `did.json` are untouched. Taking `#agent-vera` and `#vera` out of the identity is a signed version made on the YubiKeys, and it can come later. Until then, keeping the `#vera` key listed means old Vera sign-offs can still be verified.

`npm test` (build plus tests): 33 passed, 1 skipped.
params.title: Remove the Vera page, and let the DID script take a role out
